summary.text: Jeff Frese is a small-business owner from Moraga, California, and the Republican nominee for California's 10th Congressional District. According to his Ballotpedia survey, he founded a snack company and sold it, now runs a skincare company, and earlier worked in product leadership at media companies. His campaign focuses on congressional term limits, affordability, and public safety.

paragraphs.text: Lives in Moraga, California. In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey he describes himself as a husband, a father of three daughters, and a coach.
Earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the State University of New York, Cortland, according to his Ballotpedia survey.
Says he worked in product leadership at CNN, Nickelodeon, and MTV before entering business ownership.

Says he founded the snack company Fat Snax in his kitchen, grew it into a national brand with nationwide distribution, and sold it; he says he now runs a skincare company. His first job, he says, was at age eight selling wild plants door to door.
He is the Republican nominee for the 10th District in 2026; he says the campaign takes no special-interest money and has no consultants or staff. He advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
